correctness.rationale: Riemann existence reduces unmarked five branch values to nonzero spanning 3x5 monodromy columns summing zero, modulo GL3(F_p) and S5. Row spaces are hyperplanes of 4D H=sum-zero subspace, hence dual projective nonzero functionals equivalently 5-field-element multisets modulo simultaneous affine maps. Exclude exactly all-equal zero forms and multiplicity (4,1) zero-column forms; every other hyperplane has five nonzero spanning columns. Burnside cycle index has identity C(p+4,5), translations contribute p-1 only for p=5, and order-d (d|p-1,d>1) multipliers yield p phi(d) [z^5](1-z)^(-1)(1-z^d)^(-(p-1)/d). Subtract two excluded orbits. Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus. Independently enumerated affine multiset orbits for odd primes 3,5,7,11,13, obtaining 3,7,12,29,42; this finite evidence does not replace all-prime Burnside proof.
